note: Estimates of the work behind the field results. Updated by hand after each field day; method in 'method'.
method: GPS distances come from the phone's recordings, counting only stretches with readings no more than 15 minutes apart. Where a drive was not fully recorded, the distance is estimated from the positions stored in the photos taken on it, which gives a straight-line minimum. Ordinary trips that were not recorded are not counted, so the real figures are higher. Fuel is an estimate: that distance at 10 to 18 km per litre and the Hyderabad petrol price on the date shown. Routes, start points and times of day are never published.
